high_level_description: The image is a presentation slide showcasing the use of an app called "MenuGen" to convert a physical menu into a digital format with images. The slide is divided into two main sections. On the left side of the slide, there is a photograph of a printed menu from Spago, a restaurant by Wolfgang Puck. The menu is titled "Spago Breakfast Signatures" and includes various breakfast items such as Kaya French Toast, Iberico Pork Dumplings "Agnolotti," Spago's Laksa Noodle, Curry & Waffle, Assorted Fresh Fruits, French Omelet, Open-Faced Monte
